name: Pure Country Custom Embroidery & Printing
old_description: Online ordering for your school gear is coming SOON. Whether you are a player or spectator, let us help you support your team on in style!
about:
Pure Country Inc. began in 1993 in the back of a family farm shop near Menoken, North Dakota. The founders started with screen printing, then added embroidery equipment in 1995 while operating from an office suite on Memorial Highway in Bismarck. After consolidating both operations in a rented Bismarck facility, the company purchased its current building at 218 West Bowen Avenue in 2003, where it remains a family-owned business.

Today the shop provides embroidery, silk screening, vinyl lettering and decals, and a range of promotional and decorative products. All decoration processes run under one roof, supported by an in-house graphic design team that assists clients with artwork. The facility houses a modern embroidery department and what the company describes as state-of-the-art screen printing equipment, though specific machine models are not disclosed.

Customers include schools and sports teams ordering spirit wear, corporations from Fortune 500 firms to local small businesses needing branded apparel, and individuals seeking custom boat letters or vehicle decals. The company stocks and decorates garments from suppliers such as Carhartt, SanMar, Augusta Sportswear, and Otto Caps, among others.

Pure Country emphasizes personal service, describing its staff as knowledgeable and friendly and pledging to ensure 100 percent satisfaction on every order. The business was built on a commitment to making customers “look the best in the area,” a philosophy that has guided its growth from a farm-shop startup to an established Bismarck decorator.
